name: Kommandos
unitComposition:
• 1 Nob model
  • 9 Kommando models
Every model is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Slugga.

abilities.lore: Many armies employ reconnaissance units who can sit concealed, waiting for the right moment to strike.
abilities.name: Infiltrators
abilities.rules: During deployment, if every model in a unit has this ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally from your opponent’s deployment zone and all enemy units.

abilities.name: Found ’Em!
abilities.rules: In your Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That unit has +3" detection range until the end of the turn. Place one Kommando Grot token next to that enemy unit to remind you.

abilities.name: Taktikal Know-wotz
abilities.rules: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can split this unit into two units, each with a starting strength of 5. If you do, select which one of those units will have the Bomb Squig ability and which one of those units will have the Found ’Em! ability.

abilities.lore: The stealthiest warriors can evade the attentions, and the bullets, of their foes.
abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.rules: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

abilities.name: Nowhere to Hide
abilities.rules: This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Bomb Squig (Once per battle, per unit)
abilities.rules:
In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit and roll one D6:
  • On a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Place one Bomb Squig token next to the unit, removing it after this ability is used.

abilities.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS
abilities.rules:
Units containing one or more models with a [CLOSE‑QUARTERS] weapon can shoot using close‑quarters shooting (10.06). When using another shooting type, for each model in that unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models), you can only select one of the following to make attacks with:
  • One or more of its [CLOSE‑QUARTERS] weapons.
  • One or more of its other ranged weapons.

abilities.name: LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE
abilities.rules: Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. Designer’s Note: Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no wound roll is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a critical wound and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

abilities.name: BLAST 1
abilities.rules: Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add one additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form [BLAST X], each time you gather attack dice for such a weapon, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. Example: If a [BLAST 2] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).

abilities.name: TORRENT
abilities.rules: Each time an attack is made with a [TORRENT] weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.

abilities.name: LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE
abilities.rules: Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. Designer’s Note: Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no wound roll is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a critical wound and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

abilities.name: RAPID FIRE 2
abilities.rules: This ability always takes the form [RAPID FIRE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [RAPID FIRE] weapon, add X additional attack dice if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step. Example: If a [RAPID FIRE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).

abilities.name: BLAST 2
abilities.rules: Each time you gather attack dice for a [BLAST] weapon, add one additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form [BLAST X], each time you gather attack dice for such a weapon, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. Example: If a [BLAST 2] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).

Example: If a [CLEAVE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets one unit containing 16 models, you would gather three additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of six for that weapon).

wargearRules.rulesText:
The Nob can have their Choppa replaced with one of the following:
▫ 1 Big Choppa
▫ 1 Power Klaw
1 Kommando model can be equipped with 1 Burna.
1 Kommando model can be equipped with 1 Rokkit Launcha.
1 Kommando model can have their Choppa replaced with 1 Breacha Ram.
Up to 2 Kommando models can each be equipped with 1 Kustom Shoota.
